rules.port: A product file ported from NetBSD needs a PROVENANCE.toml import with upstream=netbsd, license=BSD-3-Clause, tier=A and the pinned revision; status is pending until the port lands.
rules.test-only: Tests, docs and harnesses carry no per-file NetBSD import; a product import in these paths is an audit violation.
rules.report_done: A port report marked DONE must have status=landed and its exact PROVENANCE entry; the audit rejects a DONE report with a pending claim.

claims.note: Report is WORKING; the entry must cover only the NetBSD baseline, not CUBIC/RACK
